stemMd: A safety badge is issued if and only if both the briefing and the drill are completed. Omar completed the briefing but not the drill. What follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Omar must have completed the drill.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Omar receives the badge because one task is enough.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Omar did not complete the briefing.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Omar is not issued the badge.

explanationMd: The biconditional makes the conjunction of briefing and drill necessary and sufficient. Omar fails one member of that conjunction, so he does not qualify. Completing just one part cannot satisfy both.
